question: At which of the following places did Gautam Buddha attain enlightenment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bodh Gaya**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bodh Gaya** is the place where Gautam Buddha attained enlightenment.
 
• It is located in the state of **Bihar, India**.
 
• The site is marked by the **Mahabodhi Temple**, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
